title: Introduction to Fin
snippet: Fin is a modern systems programming language where memory management is a library, the sample corpus is the normative specification, and the compiler refuses silently guessing IR.

title: Installation & Build
snippet: Build finc from source using ./build.sh with CMake, Conan, Flex, Bison, and LLVM. Check installation with finc --version.

title: Quickstart Guide
snippet: Create and compile Fin programs using finc. Learn the difference between type-checking with finc file.fin and compiling binaries with finc -o bin.

title: Hello, World!
snippet: Your first Fin program using @define printf and fun main() <noret>. Learn about angle-bracket return types and C FFI bindings.

title: Variables & Types
snippet: Local variable declarations with let x <int> = 100, type inference with auto, primitive types, const parameters, and nullable T? with denullify postfix ?.

title: Control Flow
snippet: Branching with if/else, three-clause for loops, foreach iterators, while and do-while loops, bare brace scopes, and Fin's ternary condition : then ? otherwise.

title: Functions & Lambdas
snippet: Declare functions with fun name(param: Type) <ReturnType>. Supports generic functions, const parameters, first-class lambdas, and @define extern bindings.

title: Structs & Methods
snippet: Define data structures with struct and class. Method definitions with explicit self: &Self receiver, default values, visibility labels, and operator overloading.

title: Interfaces & Generics
snippet: Define polymorphic contracts with pub interface. Nominal conformance on structs, external implements blocks, generic bounds, and constraint sets.

title: Enums & Tagged Unions
snippet: Fieldless enums and tagged union enums with member payloads. 32-bit discriminants (ADR 0041), positional access enum_.0, and enum reflection.

title: Pointers & Memory (rptr, wptr)
snippet: Raw references &T, heap dynamic allocation new [T, n]{}, and standard library smart pointers rptr<T> and wptr<T> with sound ownership and borrow tracking.

title: Blame Error Handling
snippet: Fin's unified error construct: blame condition, 'message' for assertions, blame Error(...) for raising, and blame m1778 for unimplemented paths.

title: Prototypes {K,V}
snippet: Builtin structural map type {K,V} and literal syntax {'key': value}. Structural equivalence and explicit conversion to nominal HashMap and Collection.

title: Macros & Special Functions
snippet: Compile-time metaprogramming: @macro returning quote AST blocks, bracket shaping (name!, name![], name!{}), @special functions, and #[use(...)] grants.

title: std::stdio — Standard I/O & Files
snippet: I/O primitives including printf, format!, typed print/println with Printable interface, stderr eprint, byte Stream, and FileIO static File operations.

title: std::math — Mathematical Functions
snippet: Constants PI and E, generic Number helpers (min, max, clamp, abs, signum, gcd), integer ipow/isqrt, and C libm bindings (sqrt, pow, log, trig).

title: std::strings — String Manipulation
snippet: String operations and byte utilities: len, equals (content comparison vs == pointer equality), concat, substr, to_chars, from_chars, trim, and case conversion.

title: std::path — File Paths
snippet: Filesystem path manipulation: path joining, basename/dirname extraction, extension query, absolute path detection, and memory management.

title: std::env — Environment & Process
snippet: Environment inspection and process controls: get_env, has_env, set_env, unset_env, get_pid, and exit code handling via C runtime.

title: std::time — Clocks & Sleep
snippet: System clock and delay utilities: now() Unix timestamp, sleep_sec, sleep_ms (microsecond sleep), and diff_sec duration measurement.

title: std::fs — File System I/O
snippet: Filesystem operations: file_exists, remove_file, file_size, read_to_string with nullable return, write_string, append_string, and buffer deallocation.

title: std::random — Pseudo-Random Numbers
snippet: Pseudo-random number generation: seed, seed_now with system epoch, rand, uniform random_int(min, max), random_float, and random_bool.

title: std::collection — Dynamic Array
snippet: Dynamic array Collection<T> with geometric doubling: push, pop_last, get, set, insert, remove, is_empty, first, last, reverse, and bounds checking.

title: std::hashmap — Hash Table
snippet: Real open-addressing hash table with linear probing and 0.75 load factor: exists, __get, __set, indexing operators, and custom hashers.

title: std::error — Error Base Class
snippet: Standard Error base class: message, err_code, format, and describe with C snprintf formatting. Inheritable by custom library errors.

title: std::types — Numeric Aliases & Conversions
snippet: Sized integer aliases (i8-u64, usize, byte), constraint sets (Number, Integer, Float, Signed, Unsigned), and string/number conversions.

title: std::typing — Result<T, E> & Interfaces
snippet: The Result<T, E> sum-type enum: Ok(T) and Err(E), with methods unwrap, unwrap_or, expect, select, is_ok, and is_err.

title: std::enums — Enum Reflection
snippet: Enum reflection intrinsics: getkeyid(enum_val) reads the runtime discriminant, and keyidof(Member) resolves compile-time member ID.

title: std::operators — Operator Overloading
snippet: Thirty operator interfaces in std::ops: Equal, NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, Add, Sub, Mul, Div, Mod, Index, IndexAssign, and bitwise contracts.

title: std::stdptr — Smart Pointers (rptr, wptr)
snippet: Reference-counted pointer rptr<T> and weak handle wptr<T>: shared reference and borrow counters, sound aliasing refusal, and RAII-style release.

title: std::networking — Socket Facilities & Status
snippet: Architectural status of socket facilities in Fin: specification roadmap, libc socket bridging, and design invariants under ADR 0008.

title: Architecture Invariants & ADRs
snippet: Fin's design discipline: ADR 0001 through 0042, normative sample authority, expectations (ok, error, unimplemented), and held rulings.

title: Compiler Refusal Invariants
snippet: Non-negotiable backend invariant: if codegen cannot lower a construct, it reports an explicit refusal naming the construct. Never drop code or emit guessed IR.

title: LLVM Backend Lowering
snippet: Fresh LLVM backend (ADR 0002): tagged discriminant aggregates for nullables (ADR 0040), tagged unions for enums (ADR 0041), and typed pointer maps.
